title: feat(nsze3zinc): z-axis opposite ±e_3 z-probe same-tick union own-lock: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: FORCING NEGATIVE: the band's first reverse failure. Both seeds lock along the axis that joins them ({0:+e3},{e3:-e3}), read on z-probes. Because the perp rule forbids stepping along the lock axis, the +/-e_3 content never leaves the seed pair: S^+(A)={+e3,-e3} but S^+(B)={+e1,+e2}, so no opposite pair exists and reverse fails while face still holds. Recomputed and confirmed.
